public_request: Design an incident-notification workflow for a 24/7 engineering team. The workflow must classify incidents by severity, route notifications to the appropriate responders, support acknowledgement and ownership, escalate when response obligations are not met, and recover predictably from notification-delivery outages. Produce a state model, deterministic routing and escalation rules, failure-recovery behavior, and acceptance tests covering boundary cases and one complete timestamped incident trace. The design must let independent implementers and testers derive the same recipients, owner, state transitions, deadlines, and final outcome from identical inputs.
